subject: Invariant Slot Attention kickoff — unsupervised object inventories
body: Team, kickoff for Invariant Slot Attention productization. From our release: object discovery with slot-centric reference frames — slots carry their own position/scale frames, so the model discovers objects invariantly to translation and scale, built on the scenic codebase. Data-platforms angle: unsupervised object inventories over partner image feeds, no labels required. The repo ships configs and loaders for six datasets — Tetrominoes, Objects Room, MultiShapeNet-Easy, CLEVR, CLEVRTex, Waymo Open — with the first four runnable without manual downloads, so the ramp is: smallest model on Tetrominoes (the 512-example equiv_transl config) as a smoke test by April 10; CLEVR plus CLEVRTex quality runs in May; Waymo Open scale test in June; productization decision end of June. Ivo owns staffing and the compute ask — the June scale runs are the expensive part. — Dmitri
